subject: One-time invoice / PO waiver for pilot reseller onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@strideresearch.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding — pilot invoice & PO?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the reseller pilot started. Finance on our side has prepared the initial pilot invoice (attached) for the first month of access and professional services: total amount $1,750. Our usual process is to wait for a PO from the buyer, but we heard from your team that small pilot invoices can sometimes be processed without a PO. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a PO for this pilot invoice, and if not, what paperwork you need from us to invoice?

Attached: invoice_042.pdf, stride_pilot_statement.docx

A few quick notes:
- Billing contact: Alex Rivera, alex.rivera@strideresearch.com
- Remit to: Stride Research, Inc. (TIN/EIN included on attached W-9)
- Preferred payment: ACH (bank details on invoice)

If a one-time waiver is required, please let us know what approvals you need and an estimate of timeline — the pilot kicks off next Monday so timely processing would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Partnerships
Stride Research, Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@strideresearch.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — pilot invoice & PO?

Alex —

Appreciate the quick follow. Looping in Laura from Procurement to confirm our internal PO rules and Monica from Finance for payment expectations. High level: we typically require a PO for vendor onboarding when there is an MSA or recurring billing, and for any single invoice > $5,000. Small pilots are often handled with a one-time exception but require sign-off and onboarding docs.

Laura / Monica — can you advise what we need from Stride to process this single invoice without a PO and whether we can approve a one-time waiver for the $1,750 pilot? Vendor attached W-9? Any missing docs?

Alex — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have confirmation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — pilot invoice & PO?

Hi team,

Thanks for the context, Karthik. Quick summary of procurement policy and what we need to consider:

- Policy: PO is required for any vendor with a contract (MSA/SOW) or for single invoices >= $5,000. For one-off pilot invoices under $2,500, Procurement can grant a one-time PO-waiver but only after Finance signs off and we have the vendor onboarding checklist completed.

- Required items before we approve a waiver:
  * Vendor W-9 (or local equivalent) on file (redacted TIN is OK for initial review)
  * Completed onboarding form (company description, address, insurance if applicable) — I referenced the onboarding template below
  * Business justification (why processing without PO is necessary, expected total spend for next 90 days)
  * Invoice with remit details (attached — we have invoice_042.pdf from Stride)

- Timeline: If all docs are present, Procurement review is same-day; Finance approval typically within 24–48 hours for small amounts.

Alex — can you confirm W-9 and a one-paragraph justification (pilot scope + expected spend) and upload to the shared onboarding doc? I’ve included a shared template link for onboarding fields. Once Monica confirms, Procurement will approve the waiver and instruct AP to process invoice.

Procurement reference: onboarding template — https://docs.google.com/document/d/onboarding-template

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@strideresearch.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval: One-time PO waiver for Stride Research pilot (invoice 042)

Alex / Karthik / Laura —

Following review of the invoice and Stride’s onboarding items, Finance approves a one-time PO waiver to allow Accounts Payable to process invoice_042.pdf for $1,750. Conditions and next steps:

- Conditions:
  1) We must receive a copy of Stride Research’s W-9 (received via secure upload) and confirmation of remit details (bank account last 4 digits validated).
  2) This waiver applies only to invoice_042 (one-time). Any subsequent invoices or ongoing billing will require either a PO or a contract and standard onboarding.
  3) Internal note: flag vendor as a temporary/pilot supplier in procurement system.

- Next steps for Stride:
  * Please send final invoice to AP@redwood.com with a reference to internal waiver ID WAIVER-2026-11-STRIDE.
  * Upload W-9 to our secure intake link: https://redwood.secureupload.com/stride-w9

Karthik — I’ve set AP to expect the vendor invoice and will route payment after standard remittance validation. Laura, please update procurement record and mark waiver as approved.

Alex — welcome aboard for the pilot. If you want, we can fast-track onboarding for a reseller arrangement after the pilot — please let Karthik know estimated ARR if you anticipate moving to a recurring reseller model.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance Manager, Payments & AP
Redwood Inference
